title: Fukushuu Kyoushitsu
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ayana Fujisawa, a schoolgirl bullied for no clear reason, is pushed into traffic and decides her classmates may eventually kill her. She plans revenge on the bullies, the bystanders who laughed and even friends who did nothing, using manipulation and blackmail. A 7-volume psychological horror manga, published in English by emaqi.
life_message: It shows a bullied girl reclaiming control through revenge, and asks what that turns her into.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Ayana answers years of bullying with personal revenge rather than appeals to adults or rules.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Review notes adults never investigate; the class is left to its own brutal order.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Revenge reaches former friends; no kin or civic loyalty holds.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Class pecking order of bullies and bystanders drives events.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: No religious or traditional frame in summaries.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Framed as survival: she believes classmates will eventually kill her.
